_readme: Our fixes for MinisGallery mistakes. Applied by scripts/scrape.py on every scrape; to apply without re-scraping run: python3 scripts/scrape.py --apply-corrections

overrides: '<set id>/<mini id>' (the mini's permanent key, see data/published-keys.txt) -> fields to show instead of MinisGallery's: number, name, rarity, size, image (full URL), plus a 'note' saying where the right value comes from. The key never changes, so saved collections are unaffected.

aliases: '<new scraped key>' -> '<published key>'. Use when MinisGallery itself fixes a number/name: that changes the scraped key, and the scraper refuses to drop the old one. The alias keeps the old key so collections stay attached.

icons-of-the-realms-50th-anniversary/40-.note: Vecna 1e is #42. WizKids numbering per retailer listings (e.g. Miniature Market 'DD50-42 Vecna (1E)', 'Set #40 Acererak (1E)'; RPG Mini Hunter 'Acererak 5e #41'); reported by a user from the figure. Retailers pair WizKids renders with set numbers (RPG Mini Hunter: Vecna 1e #42 uses render 43, Vecna 5e #43 uses render 44); MinisGallery has the two Vecna pictures swapped.
